gbm_population_evidence.quote: patients with IDH-mutant glioma undergoing tumor resection

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] DSP-0390: DSP-0390 will be administered orally with preferably 200 mL of water, or approximately one-half cup water.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have either newly diagnosed and suspected glioma per radiographic features, or radiographic recurrence of a histologically confirmed IDH-mutant glioma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Unbound DSP-0390 concentration in non-enhancing tumor tissue will be quantified using tissue removed during resection after treatment.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Lathosterol levels in non-enhancing tumor tissue will be quantified using tissue removed during resection after treatment.

role_evidence.quote: The hypothesis is that DSP-0390 will accumulate in brain tumor tissue at pharmacologically relevant concentrations

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral agent targeting cholesterol metabolism vulnerability in IDH-mutant glioma
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: alterations in cholesterol metabolism driven by mutant IDH increase susceptibility to DSP-0390 and lead to tumor cell death
arms: Arm A Low Grade Gliomas: DSP-0390 120 mg
Arm B High Grade Gliomas: DSP-0390 180 mg

source_quote.quote: alterations in cholesterol metabolism driven by mutant IDH will increase susceptibility to DSP-0390 and lead to tumor cell death

coder_notes: IDH-mutant glioma (Early Phase 1 window-of-opportunity); glioblastoma is not named anywhere in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels, so not_glioblastoma. IDH biomarker is mutant IDH (not wildtype), explicitly linked to the drug hypothesis, so candidate_matched true. Newly diagnosed arm entry is by suspected glioma, so IDH-mutation requirement is stated for the recurrent route and in the conditions/summary. Arms in the registry have no intervention attached; agent arms taken from the arm descriptions.
